text:
carmen: ok who wants to try a tiny two-week thing: 'Rooftop Runs & Crux Nights' 
carmen: idea: lunch runs on Mon/Wed/Fri (10-15min stair or rooftop sprints) + Tue/Thu evening 15min boulder drills at Crux. low-commit. 
finn: say less, i'm in for rooftop sprints. hope the pigeons forgive me. :pigeon: 
riyad: does rooftop have enough flights? we might need stairwell emergency backup. 
sophie: backup stairwell is fine. rooftop is just for vibes and views. 
tomas: curious about scoring. do we have one point per session? any bonuses? 
carmen: 1pt per session logged. +1 bonus if you post a pic of the view or your post-workout snack. no policing. friendly only. 
finn: can we have a mini mid-challenge social on the rooftop with tea?  
riyad: tea + towels. i'm in. 
gym-bot: POLL: "Preferred meetup for Rooftop Runs & Crux Nights" — Options: "Rooftop lunchtime (12:30)", "Office stairwell (lunch)", "Crux gym evenings (6:30)" — Vote now! 
sophie: voted rooftop lunchtime. 
tomas: voted Crux evenings. 
finn: voted rooftop lunchtime. 
riyad: voted stairwell (i'm boring). 
carmen: plan: group rooftop run Mon 12:30 this week, group boulder Tue 6:30. others do their own schedule. sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rooftop-crux (name + days). post a quick note when you log a session so people can cheer. 
gym-bot: POLL RESULTS: "Preferred meetup for Rooftop Runs & Crux Nights" — Rooftop lunchtime (2), Crux gym evenings (1), Office stairwell (1). 
finn: ok rooftop it is. i'll bring a portable speaker and questionable playlists. 
riyad: i'll bring electrolytes. 
sophie: i'll sign up for Tue evening bouldering. friend bring chalk? 
tomas: i'll be there Tue. also adding a "most improved" bonus at end of challenge. small prize: winner gets coffee+snack paid. losers bring granola bars. 
carmen: kickoff Monday. small, fun, inclusive. see you on the roof or stairs. :sun_with_face: :muscle:
